description: This is a header file defining a mock class 'readprocImplMock' for testing purposes. It inherits from 'readprocImpl' and provides mock implementations for various methods related to process handling, utilizing Google Mock.

classes.name: readprocImplMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the 'readprocImpl' interface for testing, providing mocked methods for process operations like opening, closing, and reading process information.

methods.name: openproc
methods.description: Mock method to simulate opening a process with specific flags, returning a PROCTAB pointer.

methods.name: closeproc
methods.description: Mock method to simulate closing a process handle.

methods.name: readproc
methods.description: Mock method to simulate reading process information into a 'proc_t' structure.
